storylines.storyline_label: AWS New York Summit agent stack: AWS Context (governed agentic-search knowledge graph) + AWS Continuum (AI-native sandbox-validated code-vulnerability service) + Bedrock AgentCore Guardrails/optimization analytics
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifacts shipped (June 17 summit, coverage into June 20-21): AWS launched AWS Context (auto-built governed knowledge graph exposed as a runtime agentic-search layer, access-controlled, self-improving), AWS Continuum (model-agnostic vuln-management service that discovers/prioritizes/sandbox-validates by building a working exploit/remediates, gated preview, leans on frontier models incl. Claude Mythos), and Bedrock AgentCore Guardrails (prompt-injection/harmful-content/sensitive-data screening) + optimization analytics across hundreds of agent sessions, with forthcoming Check Point/Zscaler/SentinelOne/Netskope/Rubrik detection signals.

storylines.storyline_label: OpenAI beneficial-trait reinforcement learning: small dose of trait-targeted RL (truthfulness/epistemic-humility/corrigibility/transparency/fairness/well-being) generalizes broadly and hardens against jailbreaks + harmful fine-tuning
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New research artifact (June 19, alignment.openai.com + PDF): 'Reinforcement Learning Towards Broadly and Persistently Beneficial Models' reports improvement on 44/53 independent benchmarks, cross-domain generalization (health-only training lifts non-health evals), 'selective persistence' under adversarial prompts, and resistance of instilled traits to harmful fine-tuning; framed as distinct from Anthropic's explicit constitution; self-reported, awaiting reproduction.

storylines.storyline_label: OpenAI LifeSciBench + GPT-Rosalind: 750-task expert-rubric life-science research benchmark exposing the artifact-vs-text gap
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New evaluation artifact (released June 17, secondary coverage into June 20): LifeSciBench built with 173 PhD scientists, free-response tasks graded against ~25 criteria each (~19,020 total); best model GPT-Rosalind passed ~36.1% overall, fell from 45.1% text-only to 28.1% on tasks requiring real artifacts (sequence/structure/assay files or URLs); OpenAI-authored, scores are the vendor's.

storylines.storyline_label: Bay Area / SV AI-event calendar (mainstream-dev, AI-security, AI-chip tracks)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: Carry-forward events topic (ADR-002 Rules 1+2 waived): still-upcoming forward calendar as of June 21 spans Confidential Computing Summit (Jun 23-24, SF Mint), AI Tinkerers SF Offensive Security Demo Night (Jun 25, sponsor XBOW), Snowflake virtual Dev Day (Jun 25), AIE World's Fair Hackathon w/ Cerebral Valley (Jun 27-28), AI Engineer World's Fair (Jun 29-Jul 2), AMD Advancing AI (Jul 22-23, keynote Jul 23), Black Hat USA AI Summit / DEF CON AI Village (Aug 1-6), SecurityWeek AI Risk Summit (Aug 11-12), Hot Chips (Aug 23-25), AI Infra Summit (Sep 15-17), GitHub Universe (Oct 28-29), OWASP Global AppSec USA (Nov 5-6), AWS re:Invent (Nov 30-Dec 4); Zenity AI Agent Security Summit on watch list.

storylines.storyline_label: Unsloth v0.1.47-beta local fine-tuning stack (auto-fit context ~3x usable length on a single GPU, GLM-5.2 Studio support, redesigned Model Hub, --secure mode)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Unsloth tagged v0.1.47-beta (June 18) with a new auto-fit context algorithm + multi-token prediction (~3x usable context in fixed memory; a single 32GB f16 GPU rising from ~23,040 to 64,000 tokens), full GLM-5.2 fine-tuning support across reasoning levels in Unsloth Studio, a full-page Model Hub redesign, a --secure Cloudflare-only encrypted-studio mode, and restored vLLM 0.22+ compatibility; beta, self-reported numbers.

storylines.storyline_label: Liquid AI LFM2.5 350M open-weight retrieval pair (Embedding-350M dense bi-encoder + ColBERT-350M late-interaction) for fast on-device multilingual search across 11 languages
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Liquid AI published LFM2.5-Embedding-350M and LFM2.5-ColBERT-350M (June 19) under LFM Open License v1.0, both 350M params covering 11 languages; ColBERT reported 0.605 NDCG@10 on NanoBEIR and 0.694 Recall@20 on MKQA-11, GGUF builds under llama.cpp at sub-10ms median query latency on a MacBook Pro M4 Max; self-reported, awaiting reproduction.

storylines.storyline_label: Coding-agent-harness control/security cluster: Nous Hermes Blank Slate least-privilege mode, OpenAI Codex Record & Replay, Cisco open-sources FAPO pipeline-aware prompt optimizer
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifacts shipped: three June 18-20 state-changes — Nous Hermes Agent Blank Slate mode boots default-deny (only File-Ops + Terminal, all else durably pinned off via platform_toolsets.cli + agent.disabled_toolsets); OpenAI Codex macOS build 26.616 Record & Replay captures a workflow once as a reusable skill; Cisco open-sourced FAPO, a Claude-Code-driven pipeline-aware prompt optimizer with step-level failure attribution (+14.1pp mean over GEPA across 15/18 model-benchmark pairs).

storylines.storyline_label: NVIDIA SpatialClaw training-free code-as-action spatial-reasoning agent (live Python kernel as action interface)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: NVIDIA released SpatialClaw (June 19), a training-free framework wrapping a stateful Python kernel pre-loaded with frames + perception primitives; the agent writes one Python cell per step for test-time computation. Reports 59.9% average across 20 spatial benchmarks (+11.2 over SpaceTools), consistency across six 26B-397B backbones; open code at NVlabs/SpatialClaw.

storylines.storyline_label: Frontier-lab talent war: Nobel laureate John Jumper leaves Google DeepMind for Anthropic, Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer leaves for OpenAI, set against OpenAI Q1 2026 cash burn
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New actor positions: on June 19 John Jumper (AlphaFold lead, 2024 Nobel laureate) announced he is leaving Google DeepMind for Anthropic; follows the June 18 disclosure that Noam Shazeer (Gemini co-lead, 'Attention Is All You Need' co-author) is leaving for OpenAI <2 years after Google reportedly paid ~$2.7B to bring his team back. OpenAI burned ~$3.7B in Q1 2026 against $5.7B revenue (both ~3x year-ago), ending with $73B+ cash.

storylines.storyline_label: Small-model reasoning: WeiboAI ships VibeThinker-3B, a 3B MIT-licensed dense reasoning model (Spectrum-to-Signal post-training)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: WeiboAI released VibeThinker-3B (dense 3B on Qwen2.5-3B, MIT) with arXiv:2606.16140 and coverage landing June 19; claims ~76 AIME (into 80s with test-time scaling), ~80 Pass@1 LiveCodeBench v6, 96.1% first-attempt LeetCode acceptance; figures self-reported, awaiting reproduction.

storylines.storyline_label: Physical AI: Hyundai moves to 100% ownership of Boston Dynamics, buying SoftBank's remaining 9.65% stake for ~$325M (board vote expected June 22)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: M&A event: per a June 19 Maeil Business Newspaper report, Hyundai is buying SoftBank's remaining 9.65% Boston Dynamics stake (~$325M) via a put option; Hyundai board expected to convene June 22 to approve. Consolidation arrives as the electric Atlas humanoid moves from demos into paid industrial deployments. NOTE: the June 22 board vote is today — a confirmed approval/close would be a fresh state-change eligible for a continuation bullet under ADR-002 Rule 2.

storylines.storyline_label: US export-control directive suspending Anthropic Fable 5 and Mythos 5 enters congressional-oversight phase
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New actor position: a bipartisan House group pressed Commerce Secretary Lutnick (June 18) to document the legal basis and national-security rationale for the mid-June export-control freeze on Fable 5 / Mythos 5; Anthropic says the order rests on verbal evidence of a narrow jailbreak; both models still offline globally as of June 19. G7 reporting suggested Trump signaled warmer relations after exchanges with Amodei.
